**Analysis:** With 8 vertices and minimum degree 4, consider any vertex v:
- v has ≥4 neighbors (set N(v))
- There are only 8-1-4 = 3 remaining vertices (set B)
- For girth ≥ 7, no edges can exist within N(v) (would create C₃)
- So each vertex in N(v) must have its other ≥3 neighbors in B
- Since |B| = 3, each neighbor of v must connect to ALL of B
- But then any two neighbors u₁, u₂ ∈ N(v) share two common neighbors in B, creating a 4-cycle (u₁ - b₁ - u₂ - b₂ - u₁)

This contradicts girth ≥ 7.
